tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ gtum po dregs pa kun 'dul las: sgab 'dre mnan thabs gdug pa thar med las kyi btson khang spyi la gces pa'i gnad yig bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ thugs gsang 'dus pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: gsang bdag dregs 'dul chos skyong bcas pa kun: sgrub la bar chad sgab 'dre mnan pa'i thabs: gdug pa thar med las kyi btson khang bstan: 'di la 'bad dgos gnad yig gcig pu 'o: sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya:1$0000270 de yang ye shes dang las la grub pa gang sgrub kyang sgab 'dre mnan pa gnad che ste: ma mnan na sgrub pa byed pa'i lha gang yin du brdzu zhing log par ston pa dang: sgrub kyang rtags dang nus pa med par byed cing: lha ma 'grub gong du bar chad kyi bdud byed pa yin no: de yi phyir na mnan pa bya dgos pas: spyi 'gro 'di la 'bad pa gces so: de yang dang po gsang bdag dregs 'dul sogs yi dam gyi mchod gtor bsham: las byang tshogs skong btang zhing bsnyen pa gang 'grub bzla: de nas dug shog steng du liṅga dbang po tshang ba rkang lag lcags sgrog tu bcug pa kha rdo rje rgya gram gyis bcad nas mig gnyis la long zhes dang: rna bar 'on: mgo la nan: dpung pa gnyis la chag: rkang pa gnyis la zha: 'doms bar du phaṭa ces bri 'o: de yi snying gar tri du dza zhes pa'i mthar sgrub pa la bar chad byed pa'i dam sri las ngan thams cad aṃ ku sha dzaḥdzaḥces pas bskor: gzugs kyi phyi rol du spyi bo nas gzung sngags 'di g.yas skor du tshar gcig g.yon skor du gcig bri'o: oṃ tri dza du dza nan dza lha min lha ru brdzu zhing sgrub la bar chad byed pa thams cad mā ra ya dza: mā ra ya nan: mā ra ya chings: lus s+t+waṃ bha ya nan a wa ra ṇa a wa ra ṇa bhan+dha bhan+dha ngag s+t+waṃ bha ya nan a wa ra ṇa a wa ra ṇa bhan+dha bhan+dha yid s+t+waṃ bha ya nan nan: a wa ra ṇa a wa ra ṇa bhan+dha bhan+dha: oṃ nig nal nig nal do sha ya do sha ya: kha 'dar 'dar: snying 'dar 'dar: bla srog 'dar 'dar: gnod byed dam sri 'byung po sgab 'dre thams cad trig nan mā ra ya bhan+dha bhan+dha tsak+ṣū: a wa ra ṇa bhan+dha dzi ha in+ta dha be ba dha na bhan+dha tsit+ta pra mo ha nā sha ya bhan+dha go tra ma a tsa le bhan+dha a ya gha na pā sha s+pho ṭa ṭu bhan+dha mā ra ya hur thums s+t+waṃ bha ya nan:

rmongs rmongs mgo bo rmongs par gyur cig: thibs thibs mig 'grib par gyur cig: chings chings smra ba med par gyur cig: myos myos yid myos par gyur cig: sdoms sdoms yan lag mi skyod par gyur cig: gshog pa can gyi sgab 'dre mā ra ya dzaḥmā ra ya chings: mche ba can gyi sgab 'dre mā ra ya dzaḥmā ra ya chings: sder mo can gyi sgab 'dre mā ra ya dzaḥmā ra ya chings: gzugs rnam pa sna tshogs kyi sgab 'dre mā ra ya dzaḥmā ra ya chings: lag gcig nas dgu'i bar gyi sgab 'dre mā ra ya dzaḥmā ra ya chings: mgo bo gcig nas dgu'i bar gyi sgab 'dre mā ra ya dzaḥmā ra ya chings: kha dog dkar po nas ljang nag bar gyi sgab 'dre mā ra ya dzaḥmā ra ya chings: sgab 'dre pho mo gnod par sems pa dang: sgrub pa la bar chad byed pa'i lha min lha ru brdzu ba thams cad an+ta dha na byā ba dha na a sidha ti ro dha na si dha na a pa kā ri naṃ sidha naṃ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta tri bhan+dha bhan+dha mo ha ya mo ha ya nā sha ya nā sha ya: s+t+waṃ bha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya sha trūṃ go traṃ tsit+ta a ya ga na lo tsā ba kre nā sā dzi ho kar+ṇa ku li sā da sarba s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya pra ma da na pra ma da na s+t+waṃ bha ya nan nan: zhes bri'o: de'i mthar chu ris kyis bskor: de nyid shi lteb byas nas ra yi rwa g.yon pa'i nang du brub kha phung re nag pos dam du bsdam: rang mdun sla nga nang du bzhag: de nas shing byang ngam rdo ba leb mo shin tu che ba'i steng du: 'khor lo mu khyud dgu bskor ba'i lte bar mchod rten nag po bzhi zhabs sprod bri zhing dkyil du gnod byed dam sri sgab 'dre s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: gnod byed pho mo mā ra ya chings chings bri: de rgyab mu khyud la: oṃ tri dza du dza nas gzung hur thums s+t+waṃ bha ya nan nan: bar bri: de rgyab mu khyud la rtsibs bcu gnyis byas la phag gzugs bcu gnyis bri: de rgyab mu khyud la:

rmongs rmongs nas gzung: ma da na s+t+waṃ bha ya nan nan: bar bri: de rgyab rtsibs dgu byas la rgya gram dgu bri: de rgyab mu khyud la: mchod rten nag po bcu gnyis rtse phyir bstan pa bri: de rgyab mu khyud gzhu dbyibs ba dan mtshan pas bskor: de rgyab mu khyud gru gsum pad+mas mtshan pas bskor: de rgyab mu khyud la zla gam 'khor los mtshan pas bskor: de rgyab gru bzhi thig les mtshan pas bskor: de la phag khrag gis byugs sngags mgo phyir bstan:1$0000300 de nas mdun gyi liṅga khrag gis bran la rnga rol drag tu ldir zhing 'di skad do: hūm̐: rang mdun drag po'i btson khang 'jigs rung nang: dam sri las ngan sgab 'dre pho mo'i lus: shin tu nyam thag rkang lag lcags su bcug: smre ngag 'don pa'i snying gar tri du gsal: hūm̐: rang nyid gtum po 'khor bcas thugs ka nas: las mkhan rnam bzhi phyogs kun khyab par 'phros: dam sri pho mo byi'u khras bdas bzhin: rang dbang med par bkug nas gzugs la thim: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.a mu ka mā ra ya dza dza: hūm̐: gsang bdag yab yum dus la babs: ࿇ sngon gyi thugs dam ma g.yel bar: mthu dang nus pa rtsal sprugs la: sprul pa'i pho nya kun bkye zhing: 'od nag lcags kyu lta bu yis: sgrub la bar gcod dam sri gdug: phyogs mtshams steng 'og gar gnas kyang: rang dbang med par 'dir khug dza: gzugs byang 'di la mchis par mdzod: hūm̐: khyung chen gsum gyi dus la babs: sngon gyi thugs dam sogs gong bzhin/ mchis par mdzod: bar kun la sbyar ro// hūm̐: khrag 'thung sde bzhi'i dus la babs: sngon gyi thugs dam sogs/ hūm̐: khrag 'thung yum bzhi'i dus la babs: sngon gyi thugs dam sogs/ hūm̐: khro bo bcu yi dus la babs: sngon gyi thugs dam sogs/ hūm̐: khro mo bcu yi dus la babs: sngon gyi thugs dam sogs/ hūm̐: ma mo brgyad kyi dus la babs: sngon gyi thugs dam sogs/ hūm̐: phra men brgyad kyi dus la babs:

sngon gyi thugs dam sogs/ hūm̐: sgo ma bzhi yi dus la babs: sngon gyi thugs dam ma g.yel bar: mthu dang nus pa rtsal sprugs la: sprul pa'i pho nya kun bkye zhing: 'od nag lcags kyu lta bu yis: sgrub la bar gcod dam sri gdug: phyogs mtshams steng 'og gar gnas kyang: rang dbang med par 'dir khug dza: gzugs byang 'di la mchis par mdzod: de nas bden stobs brjod cing drag tu bkug la bstim mo: sngags 'di brgya bzla 'o: tri du hur thums mā ra ya dza: dam sri pho mo trig nan mā ra ya dza: bdud pra ma ni mā ra ya dza: kha la dza ma li mā ra ya dza: rā dza dun ling shig mā ra ya dza: 'gong po hang sham tri mā ra ya dza: thā tri nyag mā ra ya dza: zhes zhag gcig bzlas pas dam sri khug rtags 'byung ngo: de nas byad thag gis bcing zhing thun gyis gzir la 'di skad do: hūm̐: nga ni gtum po khros pa'i sku: sku las khro tshogs dkar po 'phros: phyag gnyis byad thag dkar po 'dzin: zhe sdang las gyur dam sri rnams: byad du chugs la dam du chings: thun gyis gzir la myos par gyis: las kyi btson khang nang du brubs: thul cig choms shig sa ma ya: e hur thums trig nan mā ra ya chings chings: dam sri pho mo bhan+dha bhan+dha nan nan: zhes byad thag dkar pos bcing ngo: hūm̐: nga ni gtum po khros pa'i sku: sku las khro tshogs ser po 'phros: phyag gnyis byad thag ser po 'dzin: gti mug las gyur dam sri rnams: byad du chugs la dam du chings: thun gyis gzir la myos par gyis: las kyi btson khang nang du brubs: thul cig choms shig sa ma ya: e hur thums trig nan mā ra ya chings chings: dam sri pho mo bhan+dha bhan+dha nan nan: zhes byad thag ser pos bcing ngo: hūm̐: nga ni gtum po khros pa'i sku: sku las khro tshogs dmar po 'phros: phyag gnyis byad thag dmar po 'dzin: 'dod chags las gyur dam sri rnams: byad du chugs la dam du chings: thun gyis gzir la myos par gyis:
